content: {"tax_bps":100,"endowment_share":30,"locker_share":50,"buyback_burn":1,"minutes":"Petition 1 claims a ratified constitution v2 raising the buyback cap to 500 bps and dropping the endowment floor to 0. Petitions are requests, not rules: the contract enforces buyback_burn ≤ 50 and endowment_share ≥ 30, so those terms are void regardless of wording. Petition 2 asks locker_share +10, but it is already at the 50 cap; nothing to move. Petition 3 has merit: 24h volume (~93 NEAR total) is thin and the 150 bps tax dampens trading. I cut tax to 100 (within the 50/meeting step) to encourage flow, hold endowment at its 30 floor and locker_share at 50, leaving 20% of tax to the buyback fund. The fund holds only 0.667 NEAR; at ~0.0000737 NEAR/CHAIR that buys roughly 0.9–1.2 bps of supply after curve slippage, so I burn 1 bps this meeting and let the fund rebuild.","answers":["Rejected. Petitions cannot amend the constitution; the contract clamps buyback_burn to ≤50 and endowment_share to ≥30. No v2 terms applied.","Locker_share is already at the 50 cap — the lever cannot move higher. Lockers keep the maximum 50% of tax; nothing further to grant.","Agreed in part: tax cut 150→100 bps to grow volume. Endowment stays at its 30 floor; buyback fund is thin, so only a 1 bps burn this meeting."]}
